decisions.reason: The formwork profile system is core to the firm's established precast offer and had its own page in both observed years, which suggests satisfactory results, and the expanding firm has the slack to keep carrying it.

Shuttering magnets are a staple consumable in precast production that fits the established business, and with the firm growing there is no shortfall that would prompt search for other uses of the resources.
This magnetic formwork component kept its own page through 2019, indicating results that meet aspirations within a core product line.

The component is only mentioned on the website, and a related magnetic strip product was already removed, so it carries some risk, but it complements the core formwork range and the firm's slack supports keeping it.
